— Footage released by the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) shows Ukrainian unmanned surface vessel (USV) attacks on the Russian Navy's Project 20380 corvette Mercury (734), which was docked at the Libyan port of Benghazi, and the Ro-Ro cargo ship ASCALON off the coast of Benghazi.
During the attack on the corvette, one USV struck the vessel, followed by a second USV that detonated inside the resulting breach. A third USV also struck the starboard side, away from the initial breach.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy also claimed that a Ka-27 helicopter was destroyed. However, this claim cannot be verified, as no helicopter is visible aboard the corvette in the released footage.
The footage also shows projectiles flying past one of the USVs as Russian forces attempt to repel the attack.
During a second attack in broad daylight, a Ukrainian USV struck the Russian Ro-Ro cargo ship ASCALON. However, Zelenskyy's claim that the vessel hit was the Russian cargo ship ANGARA appears to be incorrect. Footage released by the Libyan Arab Armed Forces (LAAF), included in this video, shows the ASCALON being struck.
Also, the ANGARA was last spotted five days ago near Madagascar, heading towards the Seychelles.
